messages:
Maya: Quick run-rate snapshot for Atlasica — prepping QBR Friday. Need: final 30d spend forecast, alert thresholds, and an enablement ask list. Onboarding is mid-phase and embeds usage spiked this week. Renewal touchpoint looks racey if we don't surface options.

Juan: Got it. Pulling 7d/30d token deltas now, will post numbers in ~15m. Any preferred baseline for the forecast? :eyes:

billing-bot: ALERT: account atlasica crossed 68% of retainer (monthly). Current period usage: 68%. Thresholds configured: 70/85/95.

Eli: Suggest we run two forecasts: conservative (no action) and enabled (with prompt tuning + cache). Conservative run-rate -> projected to hit 100% in ~11 days. Enabled run-rate reduces per-token by ~18% in our sims. Need Juan's raws to quantify.

Rina: For enablement we can offer a 60-min workshop + quick win playbook: 1) prompt templates, 2) prefix caching, 3) embed dimensionality check. If they accept, we can cut expected embed ops by ~25%. I can draft slides and a one-pager. :spiral_calendar:

Maya: Perfect. Two asks: (1) Juan, post the raw numbers + simple projection so I can drop in the QBR deck, (2) Eli, recommend concrete alert levels and an offer that CS can present (credits? short-term commit?). Who volunteers to own follow-ups?

Juan: Posting numbers now — quick paste:```
7d avg tokens/day: 1,200,000
30d avg tokens/day: 850,000
Current month retainer: $15,000
Projected 30d spend (conservative): $18,400
Projected 30d spend (with enablement): $15,100
Days to 100% retainer at current pace: 11 days
```
(Will update the shared spreadsheet link: https://redwood.app/sheets/atlasica-qbr )

Eli: From those numbers my recommended guardrails: alert at 70% (notify CS), 85% (email + playbook), 95% (auto-suggest credits or short-term commit). Also propose a one-time safety credit offer (up to $2k) to buy runway while enablement happens. That reduces immediate churn risk.

Rina: I can run the workshop next Tue/Wed. Proposed agenda: 15m recap, 30m tuning lab, 15m action items + followups. Deliverable: one-pager + config snippets. Sample config snippet for prefix cache:```
cache.enabled = true
cache.max_prefix_tokens = 1024
cache.eviction_policy = "lru"
```

Maya: Assigning owners: Juan -> update forecast sheet + attach 7d/30d graphs; Eli -> craft the billing play (safety credit + alert policy text); Rina -> workshop slides + one-pager; Maya -> consolidate QBR deck and lead renewal talk. I'll schedule a sync for tomorrow 10:30.

Juan: Confirmed. I'll add the graphs and a simple chart showing projected burn. Will also add a short note comparing gen vs embed token mix.

ops-bot: Event scheduled: "Atlasica enablement workshop" on Tue 10:00-11:00. Invite sent to Maya, Juan, Rina, Atlasica-contacts.

Eli: One more note — if Atlasica agrees to a short-term commit we should model unit economics and show net cost per active user before/after. I can prep a slide with two scenarios.

Maya: Great. I'll include the scenarios in the QBR. For the deck: aim to present both the problem (run-rate + spin) and a concrete, low-effort path to save ~15-25% of next-month spend. Thanks all — will follow up with the updated spreadsheet and deck draft by EOD. :thumbsup:
